actual_at.description: The date and time when this Dossier data is or was actual. A dossier is created based upon processing the Mutations that affect the dossier and its properties. Deprecated, use `actual_date` instead.

actual_date.description: The date when this Dossier data is or was actual. A dossier is created based upon processing the Mutations that affect the dossier and its properties.

dossier_id.description: The unique Identifier for this Dossier in the Pension Administration.

last_mutation_sequence_number.description: The last mutation_sequence_number that was provided for this Dossier. Note that any time a new Mutation sequence number is requested for a mutation, this number increases, regardless of whether this mutation is actually added to the dossier or not.

ordinal_rank.description: The ordinal rank of the situation on the actual_at.
